text:
Predicates:
FirTree(x) ::: x is a fir tree.
Evergreen(x) ::: x is an evergreen.
ObjectOfWorship(x) ::: x is an object of worship.
Premises:
∀x (FirTree(x) → Evergreen(x)) ::: All fir trees are evergreens.
∃x (ObjectOfWorship(x) ∧ FirTree(x)) ::: Some objects of worship are fir trees.
Conclusion:
∃x (Evergreen(x) ∧ ¬ObjectOfWorship(x)) ::: Some evergreens are not objects of worship.
